mapper.select: /* CartSQL.selectCartList */ SELECT A.CART_NO AS "cartNo", A.MBR_NO AS "mbrNo", A.PRD_CD AS "prdCd", A.ORD_QTY AS "ordQty", B.PRD_NM AS "prdNm", B.SMPL_DESC AS "smplDesc", B.PRD_STAT_CD AS "prdStatCd", B.STOCK_QTY AS "stockQty", C.SALE_PRC AS "salePrc", C.CARD_DISC_PRC AS "cardDiscPrc", C.CASH_DISC_PRC AS "cashDiscPrc", D.IMG_PATH AS "imgPath" FROM TB_CART A INNER JOIN TB_PRD_MST B ON A.PRD_CD = B.PRD_CD LEFT JOIN TB_PRD_PRC C ON A.PRD_CD = C.PRD_CD LEFT JOIN TB_PRD_IMG D ON A.PRD_CD = D.PRD_CD AND D.IMG_TP_CD = '10' AND D.SORT_SEQ = 1 WHERE A.MBR_NO = #{mbrNo} ORDER BY A.REG_DT DESC
mapper.delete: /* CartSQL.deleteCartByList */ DELETE FROM TB_CART WHERE MBR_NO = (SELECT MBR_NO FROM TB_ORD_MST WHERE ORD_NO = #{ordNo}) AND PRD_CD IN (SELECT PRD_CD FROM TB_ORD_DTL WHERE ORD_NO = #{ordNo})
